# Build modes
Press 1 to 9, or click a mode on the mode bar. The Keys tab lists the mouse actions of every mode.
[bold]1[/bold] Place Put down what you picked in the palette. [bold]2[/bold] Erase Remove one thing, or everything in a box. [bold]3[/bold] Select Select, move, rotate, mirror, copy and paste. [bold]4[/bold] Fill Flood connected tiles with your tile. [bold]5[/bold] Shape Draw a line, rectangle or circle. [bold]6[/bold] Pick Eyedropper. [bold]7[/bold] Template Move and scale the PNG template. [bold]8[/bold] Pipe Draw gas pipes and place atmos devices. [bold]9[/bold] Link Signal links, device lists and access. [bold]0[/bold] Tools Wrench, bolts, weld, lock, panel and door.
Right click drops a drag in progress. Escape drops what you're doing; press it again to go back to Place. Picking anything in the palette or the quick-select bar switches to Place, so pick first, then change mode.
## Place (1)
- [bold]Left click[/bold]: place what you hold. - [bold]Right click[/bold]: erase the entity under the cursor if you hold an entity, the tile if you hold a tile. Holding a decal, it erases decals. - [bold]Middle click[/bold]: eyedropper. - [bold]R[/bold] or [bold]Ctrl+wheel[/bold]: turn it. Decals turn by 90 degrees. - [bold]Escape[/bold]: stop placing.
Properties has the placement mode and [bold]Replace[/bold], as in the spawn menu.
## Erase (2)
Set what it removes under [bold]Erase[/bold] in Properties: Everything (the default), Entities, Tiles or Decals. The cursor readout shows the current choice.
- [bold]Click[/bold]: remove one thing. Everything takes the entity under the cursor, or the tile when there is none. - [bold]Drag[/bold]: remove everything of that kind in the box. - [bold]Right click[/bold]: open [bold]Delete under cursor[/bold], a list of what's there by name and prototype. Pick one to remove it.
## Select (3)
Click or drag to select, then move, turn, mirror, copy or delete. See Selecting and editing.
## Fill (4)
Hold a tile. Click a tile on a grid and every connected tile of that type becomes yours. See Shapes, fill and erase.
## Shape (5)
Drag a line, rectangle or circle of the tile or entity you hold. See Shapes, fill and erase.
## Pick (6)
Click anything. You hold it, at its rotation, and go back to Place. A click on bare floor picks the floor tile.
## Template (7)
Drag the template image. See Templates and references.
## Pipe (8)
Drag to lay pipes. See Atmos and pipes.
## Link (9)
Click machines to wire them up. See Wiring.
## Tools (0)
Pick a tool in Properties, then click. The line by the cursor says what it would change.
- [bold]Wrench[/bold] anchors or unanchors. Anchoring snaps it to its tile and refuses a tile that's already blocked. - [bold]Bolts[/bold] bolts or unbolts a door. No power needed. - [bold]Weld[/bold] welds or unwelds a door, vent, scrubber or locker. Close it first. - [bold]Lock[/bold] locks or unlocks a locker, crate or machine. - [bold]Panel[/bold] opens or closes a maintenance panel. - [bold]Door[/bold] opens or closes a door straight away. Unweld it first.
Every click is one undo step. Ghosts don't get hands: use Test map to try things with a real character.
## Other keys
[bold]Ctrl+Z[/bold] Undo [bold]Ctrl+Y[/bold], [bold]Ctrl+Shift+Z[/bold] Redo [bold]Ctrl+S[/bold] Quicksave to your library [bold]Page Up[/bold], [bold]Page Down[/bold] Go up or down a level [bold]M[/bold] Selection on or off [bold]Tab[/bold] Next tool in Link mode
